name: BLOKU — Ad Blocker & Focus
summary: Block ads and trackers, hide distracting feeds, and schedule focus time. All features free. No account required.
matches: Matched network rules on this page
countsHelp: Current-page matches are separate from hidden elements and focus activity. They are not an exact lifetime total.
filterHelp: Choose complete lists. Chrome capacity limits apply. Your last confirmed settings remain active if an update fails.
consentHelp: Optional. Rejects optional cookies on supported dialogs. Unsupported dialogs remain usable.
gpcHelp: Exposes a do-not-sell/share preference to page scripts. The Sec-GPC HTTP header is not sent; this is not complete GPC support.
presetsHelp: Hide only the sections you choose. These controls also apply while ads are paused.
focusHelp: Sessions combine restrictions. Schedules follow your device timezone. Daily allowances count observed active time on configured sites only.
rulesHelp: Supported adblock text and CSS element-hiding rules only. Executable rules, remote subscriptions and cookie mutation are not supported. Invalid changes keep the confirmed rules active.
importHelp: Import replaces editable settings after Save. Current usage and matching active sessions stay; exported timed sessions are not restarted.
history: Keep 90 days of local focus summaries
historyHelp: When off, only today's counters needed for daily allowances are retained. Browsing history is not sent to a server.
legacyHelp: Old statistics were estimates. They are preserved separately and are not added to current counts.
localOnly: Settings and browsing processing stay on your device. No account, payment, or extension telemetry.
videoLimit: Video ad coverage varies by site. Playback compatibility takes priority over absolute blocking claims.
hidePreview: Click an element to preview hiding it. Press Escape to cancel.
noPage: Open a normal website to use page controls.
blockedHelp: This website is in an active focus profile. You control when the session ends.
profileRequired: Add a profile with at least one website first.
importReady: Settings loaded for review. Save changes to apply them.
source: Open-source software under GPL-3.0. Uses AdGuard filtering technology with attribution in the package.
saveFirst: Save profile changes before starting a session.
cleanUrls: Remove known tracking parameters from clicked links
cleanUrlsHelp: Optional. Cleans known tracking tags on deliberate link clicks; signed links remain unchanged.
adsPaused: Ads are paused on this site
inheritedPause: This site inherits an ad pause from {domain}. Change the rule in settings.
